tei:div.tei:p: 443) ༄༅/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i dbang bskur gyi las rim ji ltar bya tshul bzhugs so/ 444) om̐ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ thugs rje bdag nyid 'phags mchog gi /zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// de yi dbang bskur las rim rnams// rab tu gsal bar 'dir bstan bya/

/de la spyir bka' gter tha dad so so las byung ba'i thugs rje chen po'i chos skor mtha' yas pa dag mchis mod kyi/ 'di ni chos dbang rin po che'i gter kha las byon pa'i thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa ye shes rig pa mchog gi rgyud lasaji ltar gsungs pa bzhin gyi dbang bskur ba'i las rim khrigs chags su ston par byed pa lasngon 'gro dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa la/ thog mar sngon 'gro'i rim pa la/ rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ sgrub rdzas yo byad grogs 'khor sogs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ des tshes bzang po la babs pa'i tshe/sa'i cho ga rgyas par spros na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya ba'am/ yang na mdor bsdus te/ sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu bzhengs ba/ chag chag dang thig tshon byin gyis brlab pa/ rgyan 'god pa/ bum pa sogs sgrub rten dbang rdzas mnga' gsol ba'i las rim dang bcas pa rnams ni mtshungs med badzra dzña nas mdzad pa'i gzhung ltar bya zhing*/ skye bdun ril bu'i sgrub pa dang 'brel na'ang de dag kyi phyag len rnams kyang 'di nyid kyi ril sgrub gzhung dang*/ phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa ltar tshul ldan snga chogs su chud par byas 446) te dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bshams/ ༈ khyad par dbang rdzas ni/ gtso bum mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bum rdzas kha rgyan mgul 'ching sogs tshul mthun dang*/ yang thun mong rig pa'i dbang la dgos pa'i sa'o bum pa yang bshams shing*/ ma 'dzom na gtso bum de nyid la thus pa byas kyang rung la/ gzhan yang dbu rgyan cod pan rdor dril/ 'khor lo 'am rnam snang gi sku/ thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba/ me long*/ 'phreng ba/ thub drug gtso bo yab yum dang bcas pa'i sku'am yang na yig drug hriḥdang bcas pa'i yig 'bru tha dad kyi tsa ka li byas kyang rung ba dang/ thugs rje chen po'i gtor ma ni/

dbus su ri rab bang rim bzhi'i khar bum pa'i gzugs kyi kha rgyan me tog dang rin chen 'bar ba'i mtshan zhing*/ dra ba dra phyed sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan pa/ ri rab gyi mthar skor phyogs bzhir gling bzhi mtshon byed kyi gzugs zla gam/ sog khang*/ zlum po/ gru bzhi rnams che chung gsum gsum dang*/ phyi skor du bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ ding sang phyag srol la ni gzhal yas khang brtsegs kyi rnam par bzo ba yang snang ngo*/ gzhan yang las bum dang*/ dam tshig mna' chu'i dung chos/ me tog cod pan 'dor ba'i yo byad dang*/ spyan dar dmar po la sogs pa dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pa sman rag gtor tshogs thams cad rgyas par bshams la/ phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba'i rim pa mtha' dag dang*/ chos skyong gi bskang gso rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyi mthar/ bdag mdun zung 'brel du 'dzab kyi dgongs pa'i rang bzhin 'phro 'du rnams las byang na 'byung ba ltar nan tan du bya ste/ sgrub pa'i zhag grangs ji tsam byed pa'i ring la 'dzab rgyun bskang rgyun la sogs pa phyagabazhi ltar bsgrub par bya ba'i las rim mo/ de nas dngos gzhi la thog mar rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i rim pa rgyas par slob ma la ji ltar bya ba'i tshul bzhin du bdag 'jug len pa'am/ bsdus par byed na ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang skad cig tsam la bla bas kyang rung ba ni gsang sngags nang pa rgyud sde gong ma'i khyad chos yin pas/ de ltar rgyas bsdus gang 'thad slob dpon nyid kyi dgongs pa mtho dman dang bstun la bya zhing*/ ༈ de nas slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i las rim ni/ chos bka' 'di nyid kyi rtsa rgyud ye shes rig pa mchog gi 448) rgyud las/ slob ma dam gzhug rjes gnang sbyin// sems bskyed sgo dbye me tog 'thor// spyan dbye dal bstan dmatshig bsgrag /ces sdoms tshig tu gsugs pa ltar bya ba ste/

de yang spros pa cher byed na/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol du khrus chog dang glud gtor btang zhing*/ sgo srung la zhu ba zhu lan dang*/ nang du drang tshe bgegs bskrad dang ye thun brdegs pa sogs sgrub chen spyi gzhung ltar bya la/ bsdus pa la dga' ba na/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgrib la/ slob ma rnams gral du 'khod pa la las bum gyi chus khrus bya zhing*/ yig brgya bzlas/ glud gtor gyi cho gas bgegs sbyangs/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ maṇḍal phul nas bla mas mtshams sbyor gyi chos 'di ltar 'chad par bya'o/na mo/ bder bshegs slob mar gyur pa gang su dag /khams gsum 'di na gnasakyang kun gson cig deng 'dir ston pas chos kyi char 'bebs kyi// gang dag nyan par 'dod pa 'dir gshegs cig /rnam dag lam chen kun grol 'dir/ skal ldan gang zhig su zhugs pa// nor bu rin chen 'od 'phro ba// nges par 'char gyis brtson par gyis// de nyid sems kyi me long ste// mngon sum gsal bar rtogs ma thag 'gro ba'i lus la sangs rgyas yin// de phyir rtse gcig yid kyis nyon// ༈ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang dam pa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du chos nyan snyam pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi sems ldan pas gsan 'tshal/ de la 'o skol rnams phun sum tshogs pa'i dal 'byor rin chen u dum wa ra'i me tog lta bu thob cing*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dri med dang mjal nas dam chos spyod pa'i snod rung du gyur pa 'di don dang ldan par bsgrub dgos pa lags te/ ji skad du/ rgya cher rol ba'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas 'byung dang dal 'byor dang*// dad dang chos nyan dam pa dang*// de dag thams cad de snyed kyi// bag 450) med ma lus rnam par spang*/ zhes pa dang*/ bslab btus las/ mi khoms brgyad spongs khoms pa yi/ dam chos rkyen dang ldan pa lags// skyes bu chen po'i spyod pa yis// tshe 'dir 'bras bu bsgrub par rigs/

ces gsungs pa ltar ma 'bad na/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin yin phyir long med du 'chi ba'i rkyen gyis 'khyer bar nges shing*/ le lo can rnams 'gyod dgos pa'i dus byung tshe phyis pa yin te/ 'dul ba lung las/ bsags pa kun gyi mtha' zad cing*// mthon po rnams kyi mtha' lhung 'gyur// phrad pa'i mtha' ni bral ba ste// gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin// zhes dang*/ ji ltar bung bas bsags pa'i sbrang rtsi ni// don med mi yis dal 'byor byed pa bzhin// skyes bu ma rab sdig pas bsags pa'i lanor// shi tshe gzhan gyi longs spyod nyid du gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar 'chi ba'i tshe dam chos pa'i 'ba' shig las gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan pa dang*/ shi ba tsam du ma zad 'khor ba gang du skyesakyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin kho na ma gtogs bde ba'i go skabs cung zad kyang med de/ dmyal ba la tsha grang*/ yi dwags bkres skom/ dud 'gro la bkol spyod/ mi la skye rga na 'chi/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ lha la 'pho ltung gisdug bsngal la sogs te khams gsum ris drug mtha' dag sdug bsngal thams cad kyi gnas dang rten dang 'byung khungs nyid du gyur ba yin phyir/ 'khor ba'i gnas las thar ba'i thabs lalala'abad 'tshal te mdo las/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mthong ba las// skyo ba'i sems ni rab tu bskyed// khams gsum btson ra'i 'jigs pa la// btson pa'i sems kyi spong bar bya// zhes pa ltar 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba'i las phra zhing phra ba tshun tshad la 'dzem/bag 452) bya ba dang*/ thar ba dam pa'i rgyu dge ba'i las phra zhing phra ba nas ci 'grub la 'bad dgos te/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ sdig pa chung ngu tsam gyis kyang*// 'jig rten pha rol bde bar 'dren// don chen po yang byed 'gyur te// 'bru rnams phun sum tshogs pa bzhin// zhes gsungs pas/ rgyu 'bras kyi spang blang dang thar pa dam pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs la 'byung dgos pa lags shing*/

de sgrub par byed pa'i sa'i thabs dang lam gyi mchog tu gyurapa ni/ mdo sde ltar na pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ gsang sngags ltar na smin grol gyi lam la brten dgos te/ de gnyis ka 'bras bu thob pa'i thabs du gcig kyang*/ lam myur khyad sogs khyad chos du ma'isgo nas gsang sngags 453) kyi theg pa mchog tu zab par gsungs la/ de'i 'jug sgo ni smin byed kyi dbang nyid la rag las pa ste/ dbang bskur tshul bzhin ma thob par gsang sngags kyi chos sho lo kha gcig tsam yang nyan pa dang spyod pa'i skal ba medacing*/ lha la sogs pa bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur la/ dbang bskur legs par thob phyin chad bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len gang dang gang dag la spyod kyang 'bras bu myur du 'byung zhing byang chub kyi sa bon thebs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ gang zhig rig sngags dbang bskur cho ga mod/ gang dag dkyil 'khor du ni mi zhugs dang*// gang dag byang chub sems ni ma skyed pa// de'i gsang sngags bzlas na phung bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gsang rnying gi rgyud las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing*// dbang rnams thob par ma byas par// nyan pa la sogs 454) brtson pa ni// 'bras bu med cing rlag par 'gyur// zhes sogs dbang ma thob pa'i skyon dang*/ thob pa'i phan yon kyang*/ gsang ba mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na// skye dang skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur// de yis skye ba bdun nas ni// ma sgom par yang dgos grub thob// ces dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i rgyud las/ dbang bskur ba ni gtso bo ste// dngos grub thams cad yang dag gnas// de phyir thog mar dbang dag bya// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang*/ dbang thob rigs kyi bu de nyid// tshe 'dir bsam pa kun 'grub cing*// phyi ma mngon par rdzogs sangs rgya// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs la/ de lta bu'i dbang de dag lha dang dkyil 'khor gang lta bu ba la brten nas bskur ba'ilarim pa ni/

gsang sngags phyi nang dang rgyud sde gong 'og gi rim pa mtha' yas pa so so'i lugs kyi dbang gi rnam grangs kyang dpag tu med pa mchis mod kyi/ skabs 'dir ni 455) 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i dbang bskur zab mo 'bul ba'i skabs la babs pa lags shing*/ thugs rje chen po'i chos skor la yang phyi mdo lugs/ nang sngags lugs/ gsang ba man ngag gi lugs la sogs bsam gyis mi kyab pa'i nang nas/ 'di ni gsang sngags nang pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi lugs ltar las/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis thugs rje chen po ye shes rig pa mchog gi rgyud kyi dgongs pa man ngag tu bkol ba'i lugs ltar ston pa yin la/ de nyid gang las brgyud tshul lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyi na/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyi mes khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po nga bo chos kyi sku kun tu bzang po/ rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bdag nyid drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid/ rnam pa thugs rje sprul ba'i sku 'od dpag tu med pa mtshan dpe gzi brjid kyi phung po mtha' yas pa'i skur 456) bzhengs nas/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa rang snang ye shes kyi pho brang rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i gnas su/ nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor tshogs sprul ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po la chos kyi rnam grangs rgya che zhing rgyun mi chad pa dus gsum dus med rtag pa rgyun gyi khor mor ston pa'i ngang nas/ gdul bya dang gdul byed gnyis snang mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa mi mnga' yang*/ thugs rje sgyu ma'i rnam rol gyi zlos gar las 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs thugs rje'i bdag nyid du sku sprul ba'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad cing*/ thugs rje chen po de yang don dam par rgyal ba kun dang rnam dbyer med kyang*/ rnam pa ltar na sa bcu'i byang sems kyi tshul bzung nas sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bzhi stong gi spyan sngar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/

ji srid nam mkha' ma zad kyi bar du bdag gi 457) sprul pa'i phrin las mi zad pas 'gro ba mtha' dag gi skyabs dang lamagon dang dpung gnyen du gyur cig ces pa la sogs pa smon lam rlabs po che brgya phrag btab nas dam bcas/ phyogs bcu'isangs rgyas de dag thams cad kyis kyang dbang bskur byin rlabs lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod cing rjes su gnang ba rgya cher mdzad pa'i mthus/ 'phags pas kyang nam mkha'i gar khyab kyi sems can re re'imadun du yang gang 'dul thugs rje'i sprul pas khyab par 'gyed cing*/ phan bde'i sprin spros/ thugs rje'i glog 'khyug byin rlabs kyi char phabs pas byang chub kyi myu gu skyed par mdzad la/ khyad par 'gro ba ris drug gi gnas su rigs mthun sprul pa'i thub pa'i drug tu bstan te/ lha rnams la dbang po brgya byin dang*/ lha ma yin la thags bzang ris dang*/ mi rnams la shā kya thub pa dang*/ byol dong la sengs ge rab brtan/ yi dwags 458) la kha 'bar rgyal mo/ dmyal ba pa rnams la gshin rje chos rgyal gyi tshul du sprul nas so so'i sdug bsngal las bskyab cing*/ sdug bsngal de dag gi rgyu lasabazlog pa'i thabs dang lam la 'god par mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'phags pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur ni mtha' yas te/ spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa phyag stong dang ldan pa'i phyag re re las 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong du sprul nas 'gro ba rnams mngon par mtho ba'i lam la drang ba dang*/ phyag gi mthil gyi spyan stong las bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong du sprul bas sems can thams cad nges par legs pa'i go 'phang dam pa la 'god par mdzad pa dang*/ de bzhin du thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa/ yid bzhin nor bu/ kharsa pā ṇi/ padma'i zhags pa/ padma cod pan/ seng ge'i sgra 'jigs pa brgyad skyob la sogs pa phyi mdo dngabastun pa'i cha lugs dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba rgya

459) mtsho/ 'khor ba dong sprug gsang ba 'dus pa/ sems nyid ngal gso/ ye shes 'od mchog yang snying 'dus pa la sogs nang gsang sngags dang mthun pa'i sgrub skor so so las 'byung ba ltar gyi sku'i bkod pa dang mtshan gyi rnam grangs gzhal yas du med pa'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phrin las kyi tshad ni sangs rgyas kyis kyang bzung du med na/ so so skye bo'i bsam brjod kyi yul du ga la 'gyur te dpag tu med pa'i chos nyid do/ de lta bu'i thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gang des/ spyir bskal pa snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rmu rgod gdul bar dka' ba rnams dang*/ khyad par bdud dang mu stegs log gdug pa can dang gnod sbyin srin po'i dam sri ma rungs dregs pa can gyi rigs tshogs zhi bas mi 'thul ba'i gdul bya rnams phrin las drag po'i tshul gyis 460) tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi sgo nas 'dul bar bya ste/ dpal chen rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po dang tha mi dad pa'i rig 'dzin chen po padma sambha wa'i skur sprul te/ sku la mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par me tog padma'i sdong po'i rtse las rang byon zhing skye 'chi bgres rgud kyi skyon dang bral ba/ gsung mi 'gag tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis theg chen gsang sngags zab mo'i chos char 'bebs pa/ thugs chos dbyings mkha' dag pa'i klong nas byin rlabs ye shes kyi gzigs pa phyogs ris med pas 'gro ba'i kha lo gyen la bsgyur bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid/ bod yul mun pa'i gling du chos kyi sgron me sbar bas zhal mthong gsung thos kyi skal ldan rnams tshe gcig byang chub kyi lam la bkod/ lha srin gdug pa can rnams btul nas/ mtha' 'dul yang 'dul 461) gyi gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi sa 'dul yang 'dul rab gnas mdzad/ ri brag dben gnas kun zhabs kyis nye bar bcags te sgrub gnas su byin gyis rlabs/

zab mo'i gter chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad gter phran bye ba dgu khri sbas shing*/ de dag gi bdag por sprul pa'i sku mchog rnam lnga*/ skal ldan snying gi dbu dgu rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga*/ lo tsā ba brgya dang rtsa brgyad la sogs la so sor ma 'ongs lung bstan zhal gdams byin rlabs bka' gtad dbang bskur smon lam la sogs nan chags su mdzad de/ dus dang gnas yul so so'i skabs la babs tshe zab gter gyi mdzod phyes nas snyigs dus kyi gdul bya rnams yid bzhin gyi nor bu rnyed pa las kyang lhag pa'i bka' drin gyis rjes su 'dzin par mdzad la/ khyad par thugs rje chen po'i sgrub skor brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa yang snying 'dus pa'i chos 462) skor 'di rnams sprul pa'i chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan nyid la chos kyi gnyer gtad cing phyi rabs kyi don du gter gshog la bkod nas/ bse sgrom smug pa'i nang du zab chos 'dus pa skor dgu dang byin rlabs kyi rten rdzas mang po dang bcas pa lhan cig tu bcug nas bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab cing*/ gter gnas lho brag mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring du gter du sbas/ slad du chos rgyal chen po de nyid dag pa'i skye ba bco lnga brgyud pa'i mthar gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug tu tu sku 'khrungs shing*/ spyir gter kha chen po bco brgyad dang khyad par 'di kyi gter kha bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad pa ste/ dpe bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa mthar chags kyi dbang du bgyi na/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ gter ston gu ru chos dbang*/ rgyal sras sman lung pa/ sangs rgyas dang ston pa/ mtshungs med mnyan ston pa/ mkhas grub se ldings pa/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ mnyam med dpal 'byor dbang phyug

rje btsun nam mkha' gu ru/ rig 'dzin chen po bsod nams rnam rgyal/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du legs par brgyud pa'i dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs shing byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma chad pa'i gdams pa yid ches shing khungs btsun pa'i lo rgyus de lta bu lags/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i dbang bskur gyi rim pa 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang bcas pa yod pa las/ bdag nyid rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor dbang rdzas sogs thams cad byin rlabs nus ldan du bya phyir dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bzlas pa'i rim pa la sogs 464) sngon du 'gro ba'i las rim mtha' dag legs par grub nas/ dngos gzhi slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi skabs la babs pa lags tshe/ thog mar dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes zlos 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dgongs// thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// bdag cag 'jug cing bsnyen sgrub spro// gus par 'jug 'dod ston par 'tshal// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// gtso bo khyod kyi bsgral du gsol// zhes zhu zhing*/ bla mas lan btab ste/ kye ma skal ldan bu rnams nyon// thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'di// kun gyi mthong ba ma yin te// dad ldan bu mchog 'gas mthong srid// skal ldan bu khyod 'dir zhugs mdzod// nyon mongs nyes pa'i tshogs spangs nas// tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam sbyor ba// thugs rje chen po'i sgrub dbang gi /dkyil 'khor 465) 'di mthong thos pas kyang*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas las grol// de phyir bka' bzhin sgrub byed dam/ zhes dri zhing*/ slar yang de'i lan du rjes zlos mdzod mdzad par zhu/ bla ma mchog dang dkyil 'khor gyi// lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal nas// ci gsungs bka' las bdag mi 'da'// thar pa'i pho brang dam pa ru// mgon po bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/

de nas gsang sngags kyi snod du rung bar bya ba la/ thun mong gi skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub sems bskyed sdom bzung rnams kyis rgyud sbyangs dgos pa'i phyir/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum dang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs thams cad 'ja' 'od kyi klong na zhal mngon sum du lam me bzhugs par mos shing*/ thal sbyar gus pa dang bcas pas rjes zlos 'di bzhin mdzad 'tshal/ dus gsum 466) sangs rgyas bla ma dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dgongs// rkang gnyisagatso bo sangs rgyas dang*// zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos// tshogs mchog phyir mi ldog pa dang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// pha ma'i 'du shes nyer bzhag ste// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams 'grol ba dang*// dbyugs ma phyungs pa dbugs dbyung phyir// smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// sngon gyi bde bshegs rgyal ba rnams// sgo gsum sdom la gnas pa ltar// 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs par// bla med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems// bdag cag rnams kyis bskyed par bgyi// phar phyin drug slob sdom gsum bzung*// 'gro la phan pa bsgrub par 467)bgyi/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi pho brang gi phyogs bzhir sgo bzhi'i gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos brjod/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po yi// dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bsrung ba// he ru ka dpal rigs bzhi pos// shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi po// tshad med rnam bzhis dbyes mdzod la// bdag cag yi dam lha dang sprod// ces brjod pa'i mthar/ dkyil 'khor gyi yol ba phyes la/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ sgo srung chen po bzhis sgo phyes te/ khyod rang rnams dkyil 'khor chen po'i bar 'khyams bsgrod pa'i mos pas/

me tog gi phreng ba de nyid yi dam lha la phyag rten gyi tshul du 'bul ba ste/ de yang ye shes kyi lha thams cad don la tha dad med kyang gnas skabs su thugs rje'i'adul thabs sna tshogs phyir/ gang zag so so'i tshe rabs kyi lha skal gang yin brtag 468) dgos pas/ khyod rang rnams thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du me tog bzung nas bden pa'i tshig 'di rjes zlos mdzad pa'i mthar/ me tog dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs khar 'dun pa gtad de dor bar mdzod cig thugs rje chen po'i pho brang du/ 'brel ba'i me tog 'di dor bas/ sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i// yi dam lha la babs par shog puṣpa pratītstsha ho/ 'di skabs slob ma nyung ba dang*/ gzhung ji lta ba'i phyag len bzhin byed na/ slob ma la spyan dar dmar pos dgab cing*/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor chung ngu zhig gong nas sta gon byas pa der/ dar sna lnga sogs las bzos pa'i me tog cod pan dor du gzhug cing*/ phyogs gang la babs pa ngos bzung la de dang bstun pa'i gsang mtshan gdags pa dang*/ rigs so so gang la babs pa ltar gyi dngos grub tshul rnams lung bstan par bya la/ gal te slob ma tshogs ches pas de lta bu byed par skabs la mi 'bab na/ brda mtshon tsam du/ nas gru la sogs me tog 469)sil ma dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gtor du gzhug go de lta bu'i me tog dor ba de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su babs na mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ tshe rabs kyi lha'i skal ba yang gtso mchog thugs rje chen po nyid lags shing*/ da nas bzung ste rnam pa thams cad du yi dam gyi lha 'phags pa thugs rje chen pi kho na la gsol ba 'debs pa dang bsnyen cing bsgrub pa sogs la 'bad na lhag par 'grub myur zhing byin gyis rlabs par 'gyur bas na/ rigs dang mthun pa'i gsang mtshan kyang thugs rje dbang phyug rtsal zhes 'dzin par zhu/ de bzhin du me tog shar du babs pa rnams thugs kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba dang*/

lha yang thugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha bsgrub na 'grub sla zhing*/ zhi ba'i phrin las la dbang ba yin pas/ gsang mtshan du thugs mi 'gyur rtsal zhes bya'o/ lhor babs na rin chen rigs kyi lha 'grub cing 470) yon tan rgyas pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur bas gsang mtshan yang thugs rdo rje 'dod 'byung rtsal dang*/ nub tu babs na gsung padma'i rigs 'grub cing dbang gi phrin las grub phyir thugs rje padma rtsal dang*/ byang du babs na phrin las drag po'i rigs kyi lha dang dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur phyir thugs rje bdud 'dul rtsal zhes bya ba ste/ de lta bu'i dbang gi gsang mtshan 'di dag 'chang ba'i phan yon ni dpag tu med de/ gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar chad las skyob cing bsrung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ lha dang mkha' 'gro chos srungs thams cad kyis kyang sras dang spun grogs su dgongs par mdzad pa dang*/ 'chi ba'i dus na'ang bar do'i 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag kun la gsang mtshan dran pa tsam gyis lha dang bla ma dran/ de dran pas 'khrul snang rang grol du 'gro ba'i phan yod la/ mthar thug mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgya ba'i dus 471) na'ang*/ da lta'i gsang mtshan 'di ka dang mthun pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'jig rten kun du grags te/ gang gis thos pa thams cad phyir mi ldog pa thob par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas na/ rtag tu ma brjed par 'dzin 'tshal/ de nas ye shes kyi spyan dbye bar gsol ba gdab 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs// bdag cag thog med dus dag nas// ma rigs nyon mongs mun nas ldongs// thabs mkhas thugs rje'i gser thur gyis// ma rig sgrib pa bsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba'i mthar spyan dar yod na phye zhing*/ ched na'ang bla ma'i pyag mtshan gyi rdo rjes slob ma rnams la spyan dbye ba'i tshul du byas la dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/

khyod kyi ma rig rmongs pa'i mig /ye shes spyan du dbye bar bya// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// mthong ba tsam gyis bsam pa 'grub// 472) tsa kaṣu dzñā na pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ kye/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu rnams nyon zhig 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal mthong nas bskal pa dpag tu med pas na tshogs bsags pa las byung ba yin pas/ de'i phyir na mig gi dbang po ma yengs par dkyil 'khor ltos la/ rna ba'i dbang po ma yengs par legs par nyon zhig de yang dkyil 'khor gyi dbyibs gru bzhir byung ba ni tshad med bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i brda'am rtags su mtshon pa'o/ kha dog lnga ldan du 'byung ba ni ye shes rnam lnga'i rang bzhin du mtshon pa'i brda'o/ de bzhin du phrin las rnam bzhi mtshon pa'i sgo bzhi/ 'dod yon lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i 'dod rnam/ sku lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsigs pa lnga rim/ dngos grub zad mi shes pa'i rang bzhin pha gu mtshan dpe yon tan gyis mdzes pa'i dra ba dra phyed/ ma rig mun pa sel zhing 'gro don chag thogs 473) med pa'i shar bu dang mda' yab/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi ka ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i them skas/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'i rta babs/ stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i ri dwags pho mo/ sa lam rim pa bcu drug rdzogs pa'i chos 'khor bcu drug nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba las skyobs pa'i char khebs phubs pa/ theg pa kun gyi rtse rgyal du gyur pas dbus byur bu rin chen me tog gis mtshan pa/ chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i 'go gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pas padma'i ra ba/ nyon mongs tshang tsh-ing bsreg cing ma rig mun pa gsal ba'i ye shes kyi me spungs bar gur khang 'khrig pa dang bcas pa ni snod rnal 'byor dag pa gzhal yas khang gi dag sbyor yin la/ de'i nang du bcud rnam par dag pa ye shes lha'i

474) bzhugs tshul ni/ gzhal yas khang gi lte bar gdan padmo ge sar gyi dbus na dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po bcom ldan 'das gtso mchog thugs rje chen po yum gsang ba ye shes dang gnyis med du 'khril ba'i dbu gtsug na 'od dpag med dang*/ thugs ka'i dbus na rta mgrin dang bcas bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i g.yas su sras nor bu 'dzin pa dang*/ g.yon du sras mo gsang sngags 'dzin ma/ mtha' skor padma'i 'dab ma drug la bcom ldan 'das thub pa drug dang*/ de'i phyi skor gyi mu 'khyud pad 'khor rim pa bzhi'i dang po la sangs rgyas brgya/ gnyis pa la nyis brgya/ gsum pa la gsum brgya/ bzhi par bzhi brgya rnams bsdoms pas bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong tshang bar bzhugs pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhir badzra ratna padma he ru ka rigs bzhi sgo srung gi tshul du zhugs pa ste/ de lta bu'i lha tshogs thams cad kyang sku snang la rang bzhin med pa mtshan 475)dang dpe byad kyi dpal du 'bar zhing rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ gsal stong 'ja' 'od 'khyil bar bzhugs pa rnams zhal mngon sum du mjal ba'i mos pa dang spro ba rgya chen po mazhad par zhu/ de lta bu gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shing dbang bskur thob pa'i phan yon mtha' yas pa mchis kyang*/ dbang srog ni dam tshig la rag pa'i phyir/ gang dag 'di lta bu'i lam la ma dad log par lta ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis gnang ba thob cing dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ gas te bag med du smra zhing gsang ba'i dam tshig 'chal bar gyur na/ khyod ni mnar med rdo rje'i dmyal ba chen por ltung nas thar ba'i dus med pa'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur bas/ des na gsang ba'i dam pa la gnas shing*/ de las cung zad kyang 'da' 476) bar ma byed cig dung chos kyi chu'am/ med na las bum gyi chu blud la/ hūm̐/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu// dam/tshig nyams na bsreg par 'gyur// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// om̐ badzra u da ka ṣā/

rdo rje spyi bor bzhag cing*/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yi ji ltar bsgo ba'i bka'// khyod kyi 'da' bar mi rung ngo*/ gal te bka' las nyams pa na// mnar med rdo rje'i dmyal ba nas// 'thon cing thar ba'i dus med do// de phyir dam las ma 'da' zhig /om̐ badzra sa ma ya rakaṣa hūm̐/ de nas ye shes pa dbab pa'i ched du gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes zlos 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ rje btsun thugs rje cher ldan pa// dus gsum bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// mkha' 'gro rnams dang yi dam lhas/ bdag la ye shes dbab tu gsol// 477)lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab cing*/ spos dang rol mo la sogs tshags su chud par byas nas dmigs pa 'di ltar phogs te/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pa tsam gyis/ lus gdod bcas rnam smin gyi phung po dngos med stong par sbyang*/ rig pa'i ngo bo yi ge hriḥl thim pas de nyid gnas 'gyur te/ skad cig gis khyed rang rnams 'phags pa thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas padma rwa ga'i phreng ba 'dzin cing*/ g.yon padma dmar po'i steng na bdud rtsi bum pas mtshan pa bsnams shing longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs dang ldan pa/ zhabs rdo rje 478) skyil krung gi pad zla'i gdan la zhugs pa'i pang du yum yi ge drug ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa'i bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin pas yab yum dang 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis sku gzi brjid 'od du 'bar ba'i spyi bor 'od dpag med sprul sku'i cha byad can mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin pa dang*/ rang gi thugs kar khro bo rta mgrin dmar po phyag g.yas seng ldeng gi be can dang g.yon pas zhags pa bsnams shing khro chas yongs su rdzogs pa rngams par gsal bas/ de ltar lha rnams kyi spyi bor om̐ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po dang*/ de'i 'og tu hrīḥdamar po dang bcas pa rnams las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga dpag tu med pa ste 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i lha 479) tshogs kyi rnam par byon nas/ khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa rtse gcig mdzad par zhu/ spro na 'di skabs su gu ru tshig bdun gyi gsol 'debs dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i spyan 'dren sogs bya zhing*/ spos dang rol mos byin dbab mdzad pa'i mthar me tog gi char phabs te/ om̐ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ lo gī shwa ra dzña na ḍākki ni/ sa ma ri wā ra/ e a ra li/ sarba tsitta hri/ mdzad par zhu/ dkyil 'khor bdag po lha yi lha// bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol// byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// ji ltar mchod cing gsol ba ltar// bdag kyang skyobs pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba btab la/ thog mar thun mong 480) rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bar bya ba ste/ de dag ni thugs rje chen po 'di nyid kyi gzhung nas gsal kha ma gsungs kyang*/ chos dbang rin po che nas bzung ste rtse le rig 'dzin yab sras kyi bar du phyag bzhes la ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin du 'dir yang bkod pa yin te/ de las thog mar mi skyod pa chu'i dbang ni/ bum pa 'thogs la 'di skad du dmigs pa sprad de/ de yang khams gsum sems can thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu rkyen ni phung po lnga la bdag tu bzung zhing 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud du gyur pa la brten nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams pa yin la/ phung pi lnga gnas su dag pa ni rgyal ba rigs lnga*/ rigs lnga'i ngo bo ni ye shes rnam pa yin pas/ de mngon gyur du bya ba'i thabs ni rigs pa'i dbang lnga la brten dgos phyir/

dang po gzugs kyi phung po gnas su dag cing me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byed phyir/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin bsgom par zhu/ om̐ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddhonyahaṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags brjod pa tsam gyis khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched kyi 'dzin rtogs ma dag pa'i dngos po thams cad stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis khyed rang rnams ngo bo thugs rje chen po yin pa la/ rnam pa bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po sa gnon mnyam gzhag mdzad cing longs sku'i cha byad can du gsal bar mdzad pa'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las 'phros pas/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas gnyis med du thim zhing*/ slar 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha mi skyod pas gtso mdzad pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa ltar byon te/ dbang rdzas kyi ngo bo mi skyod pa la rnam pa bum chu'i tshul gyis khyed rang rnams la 482) dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pas/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gis kun nas blangs pa'i sdig sgrib dag me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ gzugs kyi phung po'i rang bzhin mi skyod pa'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa'i nus pa rgyud la smin pa'i nges shes mdzad pa dang*/ de lta bu'i dbang rnams bskur ba'i dus su/ sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs rigs kyi yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs te dbang gi ye shes bskyed/ sa rnying sogs byang chub sems rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing me tog gi char phabs te rab tu gnas par mdzad/ puṣpe ma la sogs mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ rnam par rgyal ba la sogs khro ba rnams kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs skrod pa'i mos pa brtan po gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐/ lha yi bdud rtsi dag pa'i chus// ji ltar bltams shing khrus gsol ltar// nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes

483) chu'i// dbang mchog deng 'dir thob par shog /badzra ka la sha a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur ba'i mthar me tog 'thor la/ shar gyi phyogs nas bkra shis don gyi lha// rdo rje sems dpa' bkra shis don gyi lha// rdo rje sems dpa'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog de nas dbu rgyan rigs lnga dar dpyangs can 'thogs la/ om̐ swa bha wa shuddhaḥ= stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin dang mnyam mazhag mdzad par gsal ba'i gsan gsum las 'od 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' bstim zhing*/ slar yang dbang gi lha rin 'byung gis gtso mdzad pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga rnams kyis/ dbang rdzas kyi ngo bo rin 'byung la rnam pa dbu rgyan cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gnas su dag cing*/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du gyur nas/ tshor ba'i phung 484) po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor sangs rgyas sangs rgyas pa'i nus pa rgyud la 'jog pa'i nges shes mdzad par zhu/ traṃ/ dngos nyid chos la dbang bsgyur phyir/ rin chen dbu rgyan bla na med// bdag po'i dbang phyug rgyal ba'i sku// cod pan dam pas dbang bskur ro// ratna muka ṭa a bhi ṣīñtsa traṃ/ zhes dbang bsgyur zhing*/ lho yi phyogs nas bkris= rin chen 'byung gnas bkra shis= rin chen 'byung ldan bkra shis= bkra shis des kya = zhes sogs kyi shis pa brjod do/ de nas rdo rje lag tu thogs la/ om̐ swa bha wa= skad cig gis khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas dmar po mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can du gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'od zer gi ye shes pa bstim zhing*/ dbang gi lha snang ba mtha' yas gtso mdzad pa'i rigs lnga 'khor nas byon te/ dbang rdzas kyang ngo bo snang mtha' la rnam pa ye shes kyi rdo rjes dbang bskur bas/

nyon mongs pa 'dod chags gnas su dag cing bya ba kun grub pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur te/ 485) 'du byed kyi phung po don yod grub pa'i ngo bor smin pa'i ngo bor smin pa'i nges shes mdzad par zhu/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje dbang*// yang dag don gyi rdo rje ste// sangs rgyas kun nas rab grub phyir// rdo rje'i dbang 'di khyod kyis long*// badzra dzña na a bhi ṣīñtsa hrīḥ zhes dbang bskur la/ nub kyi phyogs nas bkra shis= snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis= zhes sogs kyi shis pa brjod do/ de nas dril bu 'thogs la/ om̐ swa bhā wa= skad cig khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu chos 'chad mnyam gzhag mdzad par gsal ba'i 'od kyis ye shes pa bstim zhing don grub kyis gtso mdzad pa'i rigs lngas/ dbang rdzas ngo bo don yod grub pa la rnam pa dril bus dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs phrag dog gnas su dag cing bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur te/ 'du byed kyi phung po don yod grub pa'i ngo bor smin pa'i nges shes mdzad par zhu/ 486) āḥ 'gro ba'i don du chos kyi gsung*// thabs shes mnyam sbyor bdag nyid don// gsung rab dpag med sgrog pa yi// dam pa'i don du dbang bskur ro// dharma ghaṇḍe a bhi ṣīñtsa aḥzhes bskur la/ byang gi phyogs nas bkra shis=don yod grub pa'i bkra shis= sogs kyi shis pa brjod cing me tog 'thor ro/ de nas 'khor lo/ rnam snang gi sku'am/ yang na rdor dril gnyis lhan cig thogs la/ om̐ swa bhā wa= skad cig gis khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad par gsal ba'i 'od kyis ye shes pa bstim zhing*/ dbang gi rnam snang gis gtso mdzad pa'i rigs lngas/ dbang rdzas kyi ngo bo rnam snang la rnam pa 'khor los dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs pa gti mug gnas su dag cing chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du gyur/

rdo rje ming gi dbang thob pas rnam par shes pa'i phung po bder bshegs rnam snang 487) gi ngo bor lhun gyis grub pa'i nges shes brtan po mdzad par zhu/ om̐/ rdo rje'i bdag nyid rdo rje che// rdo rje ming ni bla na med// zhing khams kun tu rab grags pa'i// rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur ro// budha nā ma a bhi ṣīñtsa om̐/ zhes bskur la/ dbus kyi phyogs nas bkra shis = rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis= sogs kyi shis pa brjod do/ de ltar phyi thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba la brten nas/ sbyang bya phung po lnga dang nyon mongs dug lnga gnas su dag sbyong byed rgyal ba rigs lnga dbang rdzas rnam pa lnga'i tshul gyis dbang bskur bas byin rlabs dang nus pa rgyud la smin zhing dbang don ngo 'phrod/ sbyang 'bras sku lnga ye shes lnga'i don mngon du 'gyur bar byed pa lcags la gser 'gyur gyi rtsi thebs lta bu'i zab gnad yin pas/ de ltar thebs pa'i nges shes mdzad par zhu lags/ ces thun mong rig pa'i dbang 'di dag ni chos bka' 'di gcig pur ma zad bla rdzogs 488) thugs gsum ga dang bka' brgyad phur ba tshe dbang sogs la'ang sbyor ba'i phyag srol snang ngo*/ de nas khyad par gyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma lha tshogs dgongasasu gsol/ bdag nyid smin cing grol ba dang*// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// khyad par dbang rnams bskur du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ gtso bum blang la/ de nas khyod rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs su ye gdod ma nas kyang lhun gyis grub pa la/ gong du slob dpon gyis gsal btab cing ye shes pa bcug ste brtan par bgyis pas na/ de lta bu sgo gsum lha'i rang bzhin nyid yin pa la yin par shes pa'i nges shes mdzad pa dang*/ bdag slob dpon yang 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dngos su mos par mdzad cing*/

bum pa 'di nyid kyang phyi bum pa'i rnam pa ni sku gsum mtshon pa yin te/ dbyibs zlum por snang 489) bas chos sku spros pa med pa'i brda dang*/ kha rgyan mgul 'chings sogs kyis brgyan pa ni longs sku mtshan dpe rdzogs pa dang*/ bum rdzas bdud rtsi'i chu ni sprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa mtshan ste/ phyi dbyibs de lta bu las nang ni ye shes 'od lnga 'khrig pa'i gzhung rgyan dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i nang du 'phags pa thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor sprul pa dang bcas pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa 'di nyid khyod rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis/ lha rnams bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du mer gyi zhu nas khyod rang rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas brgyud de lus kyi nang du thams cad bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag lus lha'i skyed rim bsgom pa la dbang 490) 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mtha' dag dus 'di nyid nas 'grig pa'i mos pa brtan po gnang bar zhu/ hrīḥ bum pa spros bral chos sku zlum// bcud ni longs spyod yi dam lha// sprul sku'i khrus kyis ma rig 'khrus// lha dbang lus la rdzogs gyur cig om̐ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hriḥ ka ya a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum bskur zhing*/ rol mo 'dzab dbyangs la sogs pa.a byin phab so/ de nas gsang dbang ni/ thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba 'thogs la/ de nas yang khyed rang rnams 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i skyed rim gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs yab yum thabs shes mnyam sbyor gyi sbyor mtshams nas zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa mtshan ka sa la'i nang du 'khyil ba khyod rang rnams kyi mgrin par bzhag cing blud de dbang bskur bas/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags

491) pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyang zhing dag rtsa khams bde ba'i ye shes bcud kyis gang ste gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag bzlas pa gsung gi 'khor lo nyams su len pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin pas de dang mthun pa'i nges shes mdzad par zhu/ hrīḥ gsang ba ye shes bdud rtsi che// byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'dur gsal// rtsa khams bde ba'i rang bzhin la// thabs shes zung 'jug dbang thob shog /om̐ ma = bo dhi tsitta a ho su kha/ wa ka a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur zhing bdud rtsi blud do/ dbang 'di nyid thob pas ni phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod bgyid par dbang ba yin pas na/ phyi ltar bsnyen pa ni/ rang nyid thugs rje po yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi bor 'od dpag med/ thugs khar rta mgrin dang bcas pa'i lha gsum so so'i thugs khar zla ba'i 492) dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar yig drug gis bskor bar dmigs te bzlas pa bya zhing*/ de yang thugs rje chen po'i thugs kha'i hriḥdang sngags phreng dkar po las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la sku mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul zhing*/ sku'i dgos grub thams cad rang nyid thim par dmigs/ 'od zer khams gsum gyi sems can rnams la 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang zhing 'phags pa'i sku'i go 'phang la bkod par dmigs la bkod par dmigs la yig drug bzla/ de bzhin du spyi gtsug mtha' yas kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags dang bcas pa'i 'od zer dmar pos rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung la mchod cing gsung gi dngos grub bsdus/ sems can rnams kyi ngag sgrib sbyang nas gsung gi go 'phang la bkod/ rta mgrin thugs kha'i 'od zer mthing gas rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs la mchod cing thugs kyi dngos grub bsdus/

sems can rnams kyi 493) yid sgrib sbyang ste 'phags pa'i thugs kyi go 'phang la bkod par bsam zhing yig drug bzla ba ni phyi'i bzlas pa'o/ lha gsum gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer rnams sprul pa'i kho mo dang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi tsha tsha 'phro ba ye shes kyi me spungs dang bcas pa 'jig rten gyi khams gang bar 'phros pas/ gang dag zhi bas mi 'thul ba'i bdud bgegs log 'dren bar chad thams cad rdul du rlog par dmigs nas/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ om̐ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes yi ge bcu gcig pa drag por bzla ba ni nang gi bzlas pa dang gsang ba rdzogs rim ltar na/ rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yig drug rdo rje'i bzlas par ye nas lhun gyis grub pa ste/ de yang rlung nang du rngub pa ni om̐ dang ma/ khong du gnas pa ni ṇi dang pad/ phyir 'byin pa ni me dang hūm̐ hrīḥdang bcas pa rgyun chags su rang shugs kyis 494) 'grub pas na rtsol bcas kyis bzlas pa la rag ma lus pa ste/ de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i bzlas pa rnams la rgyun du brtson par mdzad 'tshal/ 'di skabs su spro na ye shes rig pa'i 'dzab dbyangs yang bya zhing*/ bla mas 'phreng ba 'thogs pa'i sna gcig slob mas bzung nas 'dren cing yig drug gi bzlas lung 'bogs pa yang phyag bzhes so/ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang mtshon byed me long 'thogs la/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi cha byad rus brgyan gar stabs can la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gsal ba las mos gus gdung shugs bskyedacing ting 'dzin rgyud la skye bar yid kyis gsol ba btab/ slar rang gi snying gar rig pa'i ngo bo hrīḥ yang mar me lta bu 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig la sems rtse gcig gtad de gzhan du skad cig kyang ma ma yengs par mdzod cig 495) hrīḥ 'khor ba myang 'das kun gyi gzhi// rang sems rig na 'ching grol med// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// sna tshogs rang grol rig pa'i dwangs// skal ldan khyod kyis thob par shog

/tsitta badzra sa ma dhi dzña na a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes snying gar bskur la/ de yang me long zlum po ni chos sku thig le nyag gcig gi dpe mtshon la/ dwangs shing gsal ba ni gdangs 'gag med longs sku dang*/ gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'char ba ni rtsal sprul sku cir yang 'char ba'i brda mtshon pa'i dbang bskur bas yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag cing*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rdzogs rim gsal stong zung 'jug bsgom pa dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ 'di skabs su chos gzhan du las kyi phyag rgya sogs la brten pa'i bde stong zung 'jug gi dbang don ngo sprod pa yin la/ 'dir gsal stong zung 'jug la ngo sprod pa ste/ don la khyad med de rang rig lhan skyes kyi ye shes rang ngo shes pa'i thabs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang du nam yang dgongs pa mthun no/ de nas dbang thams cad gi mthar thug tshig dbang rin po che rig pa rtsal gyi dbang ni kun rdzob rdzas kyi dbang la mi ltos pa'i phyir/ ye shes rig pa mchog gi rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig gis ngo sprod pa yin pas/ sems ma bcos rang babs glod nas gsan 'tshal/ hrīḥ sems nyid gsal la 'dzin rtog med// me long lta bur rtogs pa na// dran rtog chos kyi dbyings su nub// zug rngu bral ba'i bde ba che// de ni gnas mchog rig pa'i dbang*// sems nyid gsal la 'dzin rtog med// me long lta bur rtogs pa na// tha mal sgo gsum sku gsung thugs// cir mi dgongs la thugs rje che// de ni lha mchog rig pa'i dbang*// 497) sems nyid gsal la 'dzin rtog med// me long lta bur rtogs pa na// sgo lnga yul dang gnyis med mchod// de ni mchod tshogs rig pa'i dbang*// sems nyid gsal la = me long lta bur= 'gro don bya byed lhun gyis grub// de ni gzhan don rig pa'i dbang*// sems nyid gsal la=

me long lta bur rtogs= 'du shes bral bas 'khor ba dag de ni dong sprug rig pa'i dbang*// thugs rje chen po'i dbang don ni// thams cad ye sangs rgyas pa'i dbang*// rtogs shing rang dbang rang gis bsgyur// bskur thob rtsod bral bde chen yin// zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor 'das snang srid kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang rig byang chub sems kyi rol par rtogs phyin chad cir snang cir shar thams cad thugs rje chen por ma gyur pa rdul tsam yang med tshe/ chos nyid rnam rol khyab gdal chen po'i spyod pa las 498) mi 'da' ba ni dbang thams cad kyi rgyal pi yang yin la/ man ngag nyams len thams cad kyi snying po yin pas/ de lta bu'i don la goms par byos shig ༈ de nas 'gro 'dul gyi dbang ni thub drug dang gtso bo yab yum gyi sku'am yig 'bru'i tsa ka li 'thogs la rim pa bzhin tshig dang mthun par 'askur te/ de ltar dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtha' rten 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang bskur ba'i sprul pa 'gro 'dul gyi lha tshogs/ rnam pa ni yig drug hrīḥdang bcas pa 'di dag gis dbang bskur bas/ 'phags pa'i lha tshogs de dag rnams dang dbyer med pa'i thugs rje dang phrin las la mnga' brnyes par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ om̐/ lha dbang brgya byin sku gsung thugs// lha rnams 'dul ba'i srog rnying om̐// om̐ zung lha yi 'gro ba thul// lha yi 'khor ba stong par shog thags bzang ris kyi sku gsung thugs// lha min 'dul pa'i srog rnying ma// ma zung lha 499) min 'gro ba thul// lha min 'khor ba stong par shog /ṇi/ shākya thub pa'i sku gsung thugs// mi rnams 'dul pa'i srog rnying ṇi// ṇi zung mi yi = mi yi 'khor ba = pad/ seng ge rab brtan sku gsung thugs// byol song 'dul pa'i srog rnying pad// pad zung byol song = byol song 'khor ba = me/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sku gsung thugs// yi dwags 'dul pa'i srog rnying me// me zung yi dwags 'gro =

yi dwags 'khor ba = hūm̐/ chos kyi rgyal po sku gsung thugs// dmyal ba 'dul ba'i srog rnying hūm̐// hūm̐ zung dmyal ba'i 'gro = dmyal ba'i 'khor ba stong = hrīḥ thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs// bder bshegs 'dul ba'i srog rnying hrīḥ hrī zung 'khor ba dong nas sprug rgyud drug 'khor ba stong par shog om̐ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur ro/ skabs 'dir skye bdun ril sgrub dang 'brel na de nyid kyi bum pas dbang bskur ba 500) ni 'di yi dbang rkyang pa la ni mi dgos mod kyang*/ ding sang phyag srol ltar na bar 'dir bum pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du ril bu thugs rje chen po'i ngo bor bzhugs pa rnams slob ma'i lus la thim pa'i dmigs pa sprad cing*/ hrīḥ bum pa zlum po spros bral chos kyi sku// phyi ni gzhal yas nang ni yi dam lha// thugs rje chen po'i bum pa'i dbang bskur bas// sku gsung thugs gi dbang mchog thob par shog ces yig drug gi 'dzab dang bcas te bskur ba'i phyag srol snang ngo*/ de nas gtor ma 'thogs la/ gtor ma 'di nyid ye shes 'od lnga 'khrig pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du/ 'phags pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa rnams kyi sku'i gnas lnga nas ye shes kyi 'od zer sna lnga 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi gnas lngar thim pas/ dug lnga dug gsum las dang nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang dang byin rlabs yongs rdzogs su thob pa'i mos pa mdzad par zhu/ 501) hrīḥ chos sku skye ba med pa las// longs sku rgyal ba'i lha tshogs shar// thugs rje sprul sku bla na med// gtor ma sku gsum yongs rdzogs kyis//'bras bu sku bzhi mchog thob shog /om̐ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥkā ya wāka tsitta a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur zhing*/ gtor ma dngos grub tu bkye bar bya'o/

de ltar thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i dam tshig tu/ spyir 'gro ba sems can kun la gnod 'tshe spong zhing phan pa ci nus bsgrub/ sgos su rdo rje'i slob dpon la sangasargyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang*/ mched lcam rnams la dkyil 'khor 'du shes rtag tu bya/ khyad par du sku'i dam tshig tu lus kyi sgo nas mi dge ba mtha' dag spang zhing phyag 'tshal skor ba la sogs la 'bad pa dang thugs rje chen po'i skyed rim sgom/ gsung gi dam tshig tu ngag gi nyes pa spangs nas kha don chos spyod dang yig drug la 'bungs/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu yid kyi mi dge ba mtha' dag spang ste dag snang sbyang zhing stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi nyams len la brtson par bya ste/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig sa ya 'bum sde gsungs kyang rtsa ba 'di dag tu 'du bas na/ blang lador tshul bzhin 'bad pas rang lagazhan gyi don gnyis 'grub par mdzad 'tshal/ de nas shis brjod dang tshogs kyi dga' ston bya zhing*/ rjes kyi las rim mtha' dag ni spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ de ltar thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i dbang bskur 'di ni rgyas par dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs su bkod pa yin la/ bsdus par byed na thun mong rig pa'i dbang rnams bzhag pa'am/ yang na deng sang gsang sngags 'chal ba'i dus dbang gis/ skye bo phal ba la khrom dbang lta bur byed dgos pa'i tshe na/ sngon 'gro gzhan rnams bzhag chos bshad/ skyabs sems/ ye shes dbab pa rnams byas la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga*/ 'gro 'dul gyi dbang dang*/ gtor dbang rnams byas kyang rung bas/ mdor na slob dpon nyid kyis gang 'gabs skabs dang bstun shes par bya'o/ 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bla ma rin po che rgyal sras dbang phyug pas bskul bar mdzad pa ltar/ thugs rje chen po la mos pa'i btsun pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis rgod tshang dpal gyi ri bor bkod pa'i dge bas/
'gro kun thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la 'khod par gyur cig maṅga lam/
